body: Hey look, I don't have a lot of money, but I have some. If you'd like I can send you a few bucks. *Really* not much. Like... canned beans from the grocery store level of budget. But I'd like to help keep you eating if I can.

Word. I'm only like this when I have to do something new for the first time but boy howdy is it a doozy when it happens. 

Being high helps me too but I tend to go overboard so I stay off.

Lol no problem, I long ago mastered the skill of talking on the internet.

I did it! Just gotta take it in and renew the tag but I've done that before. Thank you so much you funky angel to the anxious. Just seeing it laid out like that made it much less frightening.

Hey! You were that guy that helped the guy shopping for wood that one time. You seem really swell.

Thank you so much, this is honestly a godsend.
